archetypes.name: publish-state-machine
archetypes.rationale: The plan changes Step 5c resume gates, publish envelopes, skipped-publish outcomes, and summary rendering across several scripts, so a state-machine reviewer can catch contract gaps between those surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed changes preserve a coherent publish state machine across plan write success, publish success, publish failure, missing SESSION_ID, resume sentinels, rename cleanup, and reentry markers. Check that every state described in the plan is supported by the scoped scripts, SKILL.md orchestration text, tests, and docs without contradictory gates or misleading operator summaries. Pay special attention to the claimed true writer of .completed/step-5c and whether clarify-publish parity is covered by evidence in the listed files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
